title: NFTmon
tagline: NFTMon is an on chain game built using MUD. NFTMon is a multiplayer game inspired from MUD
description:
NFTmon is a multiplayer game that involves users to play game with other users simultaneously on chain. Player picks an emoji before he/she can enter the game and once the emoji is selected he/she can play it with anyone.

Once anyone is won, that player is issued an NFT of the same emoji as a reward
how_its_made:
NFTMon is made using Lattice, Mud, and NFT.Storage is used to store the NFTs.
By using NFT.storage CAR feature, user will have to no more wait for the image to upload and the CID will be given prior to the user so that it can be stored on chain.
By using MUD players can seamlessly play game on chain with the security of ethereum.
